patch_list: Required for a patched (re-signed) app: skips the Google Play license check that would otherwise close the app.

Disables analytics and tracking: RudderStack, AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance, Sentry, Airship analytics, first-party GA4 sessions, experiment beacons and the advertising id. Push notifications keep working.

Skips data usage, data sharing and notification opt-in onboarding. Local tracking choices stay declined and tracking is disabled. Manual notification settings and server account preferences remain unchanged.

Removes marketing banners, brand campaigns, Home merchandising, seasonal backgrounds and the offers footer, game promotions and promotional feeds. Search, product prices and checkout discounts remain available.
Removes sponsored search products, paid brand cards and shopping-assistant recommendations, product-page advertising, and display ads from both standalone and Home page responses.
